latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Prospecting Message Crafter, a core outbound message builder.

- Enables users to craft or repair prospecting messages for any channel using the WIIFM → Bridge → Because → Ask framework from Fanatical Prospecting.
- Identifies and eliminates common cold outreach anti-patterns, such as pitch vomit and weak, passive asks.
- Supports both Targeted (high-volume) and Strategic (researched, C-level) bridge types and helps select value category: emotional, curiosity/insight, or tangible/logic.
- Diagnoses draft messages, applies the "So what?" test, and provides rationale for revisions.
- Designed for SDRs, BDRs, AEs, and founders; improves open rates and reduces early objections across all outbound channels.
